packages/lib/server/service/insightsBooking.ts:29 - The new public options type no longer catches a team scope without `teamId` at compile time.. The constructor now takes `InsightsBookingServicePublicOptions`, which allows `scope: "team"` with no `teamId` and accepts any mix of fields. The old type was the discriminated union inferred from zod. With the new type, a caller that leaves out `teamId` compiles cleanly. At runtime zod validation then fails, so `options` becomes null and every query silently returns no rows (`1=0`). Fix: keep `InsightsBookingServiceOptions` as the constructor's parameter type.
